component.name: Isabellum
component.summary: Isabelle theories as literate documents, worked on with agents

description.p: Isabellum opens a folder of Isabelle theories as a literate document and a source editor, checked continuously by one shared prover that coding agents use too, on this computer or another.

ul.li: A literate view set like the generated LaTeX document, and a source view with Isabelle symbols
Goals at any position, Sledgehammer and Find Theorems
Sessions that keep running when the window closes, with Pause, Stop and Resume
Agents edit only where you grant rights; your undo is your own, and their changes are reverted one by one
